notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (9): An Unusual Amount Of Fear, Rebel Strike Team, Endor, Endor: Rebel Landing Site, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Strike Planning (posted 'Strike Planning(usually)'); these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Strike Planning(usually)' dested Strike Planning (Death Star II), not a later virtual card.
The post's 'Unknown(2)' header was a section label, not a card; its two cards are Deactivate The Shield Generator and I Did It!.
Posted 'EPP Luke/Han/Leia/Obi' dested Luke With Lightsaber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Leia With Blaster Rifle and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber.
Posted 'Qui-gon with saber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber, which the wiki lists in Theed Palace (released 12 December 2001, after this post).

Shields named in the post are the Reflections III Defensive Shield printings (Aim High, A Tragedy Has Occurred, Battle Plan, Wise Advice, Your Insight Serves You Well, Don't Do That Again and Do, Or Do Not share titles with older Effects).
The strategy cites the author's FreedomCon tournament report (Game #7, a win over Mike Gemme's Lightsaber Combat deck).
player_note: His tournament report says both posted decks are slightly modified versions of what he actually played.
